summary: Full audit of the customer depot (19 /dashboard routes) and the admin area (38 sidebar links), plus the payout flow, the overdraft guard and bank logos. Seeded tester@mester.de through the admin API with: Festgeld ABN AMRO 10k at 3.1% for 12 months, Tagesgeld BGL BNP 5k, AAPL x10 at 150, bond DE0001102580 with nominal 2000, Kurs 98.5, Kupon 2.1 and maturity 2032-02-15, and one PDF. Everything was cleaned up afterwards (assets 0, no pending payouts, cash 300 EUR). Backend: new pytest 12/13 pass (the one failure is weak IBAN validation) and iter68 regression 12/12 pass. The payout flow works end to end in API and UI: reserve, reject releases, approve settles, double approve gives 409, too high gives 400 with a toast. The overdraft guard gives 400. All banks have logo_url and every logo file resolves. The admin offers list returns 298. Customer Festgeld/Tagesgeld cards and Mein Depot show real bank logos. Found several HIGH bugs: /admin/cash-balances is completely broken, the admin order list endpoint is missing, the admin offers tables have no logos, the bond field mapping is wrong so P/L numbers are wrong, and Kontoauszug totals are wrong. I fixed 2 blockers myself: an /admin/offers crash and a 500 on /api/admin/depot-contracts/list.

critical.issue: Endpoint does not exist (404). AdminStockOrders.js:108 calls it and swallows the error with .catch(() => ({data: []})), so the admin 'Kauf- und Verkaufsaufträge' page (badge 3) can never list or execute pending customer orders. Only POST execute/match/reject/notify exist in routes/portfolio.py:1183-1290.
FIXED BY TESTER: returned 500 because admin-created depot_contracts store user_id as an ObjectId, which cannot be JSON-serialized. routes/admin_reads.py:153 now converts ObjectId values to str.

minor.issue: IBAN check (admin_customer_assets.py:450) is regex only, with no country check and no mod-97 checksum. 'XX12 abc def ghi jkl' was accepted (201) as XX12ABCDEFGHIJKL.
Check-then-insert race: the available balance is read and the ledger event is written without a lock or transaction, so two parallel requests can overdraw. Use a per-user lock or a conditional write.
The 400 message uses an unlocalized amount: 'verfügbares Guthaben (300.00 €)'. It should be 300,00 €.

When laufzeit_monate is given without active_until, no end date is derived (admin_customer_assets.py:161-176). The customer sees 'Enddatum –' and 'Fälligkeitsverlauf: Keine Festgeld-Fälligkeiten geplant', yet 'Restlaufzeit 66 Tage' at the same time. lock_until also stays null.
Returns avg_cost/coupon_rate/maturity_date/cost_basis, but the frontend expects kaufkurs/kupon_rate/faelligkeitsdatum/kaufdatum (see the frontend issue). Fix either side.

ui_bugs.issue: Every booking fails with 422 and the toast shows 'Fehler: [object Object],[object Object],[object Object]'. The payload in lines 141-147 has no idempotency_key, sends direction/event_type to /cash/deposit (extra=forbid), and sends description instead of reason to /cash/adjustment. The balance column also shows 0,00 € for every user (tester really has 300 €). The type select still offers 'Gebühr' and 'Korrektur' with a negative sign, so admin debits remain possible, against the owner rule.
ui_bugs.selector: Einzahlung button in the row -> form

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: offer.min_deposit.toLocaleString crashed the whole /admin/offers page (blank) because DKB Tagesgeldkonto has min_deposit null. Changed to Number(offer.min_deposit || 0).

Bond field mismatch (kaufkurs/kupon_rate/faelligkeitsdatum vs API avg_cost/coupon_rate/maturity_date) makes bondsEinstand 0. Results: Anleihen page shows EINSTAND 0,00 €, KURS-G/V +1.970 € but +0.00 %, Ø KUPON 0 %, FÄLLIGKEIT –, Kaufkurs –. Übersicht shows 'UNREALISIERTER G/V +1.970,00 € +131,33%'. Mein Depot shows 'INVESTIERT 1.500 €' and 'GESAMT G/V +3.547,80 € +236,52 %'. All wrong.

Line ~70 hardcodes setContracts([]), so FESTGELD/TAGESGELD shows 0,00 € and GESAMTVERMÖGEN shows 3.770 € instead of 19.126 €. Kontobewegungen: the sign ignores direction (debits show as '+5,55 €' in green), Saldo is always 0,00 € (balance_after is not provided by the API), raw types are shown ('adjustment'/'withdrawal'), and pending/cancelled events are listed as normal movements. Bonds use the issuer instead of the bond name.
currency = p?.currency || 'USD' ignores the position currency (EUR). The positions table shows '150,00 $' and '1.500,00 $' while the rest of the page shows €. Use m.currency || 'EUR' as the fallback.

fetchUsers() (lines 117-120) sets users to [], so the Benutzer column shows '–' plus the raw user_id. The bank column reads c.banks?.name but the list API returns bank_name, so it shows '–'. There is no bank logo.
The 'Auszahlungsanträge' badge is stale: it still showed 2 after both requests were decided. Refresh the badge after approve/reject.
'{offer.deposit_term} M' renders as ' M' for Tagesgeld (term null). Rates format inconsistently: '4%' here vs '4,00%' on /admin.

integration_issues.issue: Requirement not met. /admin (AdminDashboard.js:527) and /admin/offers (AdminOffers.js:258, Building2 icon) show all 298 offers without any bank logo, although the API returns banks.logo_url. The admin customer detail contract list (AdminUserDetail.js:761) and /admin/depot-contracts also show no logos.
DepotPage.jsx ~line 500 'Größte Verträge' rows show the bank name without a logo. The Festgeld/Tagesgeld cards and Mein Depot do show logos.
BondLogo tries t3.gstatic favicon and unavatar.io for bund.com, which returns 404 console errors on Übersicht/Anleihen/IPO. These are noisy but fall back.

issues: The visitor welcome/cookie gate also appears for logged-in admins on /admin/* and blocks clicks until it is accepted.
The ABN AMRO logo renders very small inside the 48px tile (wide logo).
Native browser date pickers (mm/dd/yyyy) are used instead of the shadcn calendar and do not follow the German format.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix AdminCashBalances.js handleTxSubmit. Send {user_id, amount, description, idempotency_key: crypto.randomUUID()} to /cash/deposit, show the real ledger balance per user, remove the debit types (Gebühr/Korrektur negative) per the owner rule, and render 422 detail arrays as readable text.
HIGH: Add GET /api/admin/portfolio/orders (list stock_orders with status filter and user info) so /admin/stock-orders works, and stop silently swallowing the error.

HIGH: Add BankLogo (offer.banks.logo_url) to the bank column in AdminOffers.js:258 and AdminDashboard.js:527, plus AdminUserDetail.js:761 contract list, AdminDepotContracts.js and DepotPage.jsx 'Größte Verträge'.

HIGH: Align the bond fields. Either map kaufkurs=avg_cost, kupon_rate=coupon_rate, faelligkeitsdatum=maturity_date and kaufdatum=created_at in /api/portfolio/bond-positions, or fix DashboardDataContext/AnleihenPage. Then re-verify Übersicht, Mein Depot and Anleihen G/V and Einstand.

HIGH: Statement.js: load /api/portfolio/depot-contracts instead of setContracts([]), apply the debit sign, compute the running Saldo, translate the types, and exclude or mark pending/cancelled events.
MEDIUM: add_contract should derive active_until (and lock_until for festgeld) from active_from + laufzeit_monate.
MEDIUM: AktienPage currency fallback should use the position currency (EUR) instead of 'USD'.
MEDIUM: AdminDepotContracts: load users (/api/admin/users) and use bank_name/bank_logo_url from the list API.
LOW: IBAN mod-97 validation, a German amount format in the payout error, a lock against the payout race, refreshing the sidebar payout badge after decisions, and 'null M' term in AdminOffers.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_customer_assets.py _decide_payout updates the request status first and then the ledger without a transaction. If the ledger update fails, the request is 'approved' but the money is still pending.
AdminStockOrders.js and AdminDepotContracts.js silently catch API errors and render empty lists, which hides broken endpoints.
Two BankLogo components exist (components/BankLogo.js and components/bank/BankLogo.jsx) with different props and fallbacks. Consolidate them.

The earlier iter68 tests created permanent 'TEST debit/credit' ledger rows that the customer sees in the cash history and Kontoauszug. The ledger is immutable, so consider hiding source=admin TEST rows or running the tests on a dedicated QA user.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (payout flow and customer pages load; admin cash-balances, stock-orders and admin logos fail; several wrong numbers)

seed_data_creation: Seeded and then deleted (iter69_seed.py seed/clean): 2 contracts, AAPL, bond DE0001102580, PDF. Payout test requests were all approved (5.55 + 50 + 8 EUR, then re-credited via admin credit adjustments 'TEST restore payout') or rejected. Final tester state: cash 300.00 / available 300.00, no assets, no pending payouts.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. Use python tests/iter69_seed.py seed|clean to populate the tester depot. Remove [data-testid=visitor-welcome-gate] via JS (it also appears on admin pages and intercepts force clicks). Login via page.request.post('/api/auth/login') shares cookies with the page. Admin confirm/prompt dialogs on /admin/payout-requests need a page.on('dialog') accept handler. The LLM budget is exhausted ('LLM-FEHLER' label on /admin is just a news-pipeline stat label, not an error).
rca of the issue: Bond P/L: the API emits English field names while the dashboard context computes Einstand from b.kaufkurs, which is undefined, so 0. Kontoauszug: Statement.js was migrated off Supabase with contracts hardcoded empty. Cash-balances: the frontend payload was never updated to the pydantic extra=forbid models that require idempotency_key/reason. Admin offers crash: one seed offer has min_deposit null. Depot-contracts 500: the new admin asset route stores ObjectId user_id, which admin_reads did not serialize.
